name: text_beside_a_block_survives_a_sibling_restyle
description: LAYOUTPERF8 (latent bug A). A block page: #mover, and #mixed holding text beside a block (the text sits in an anonymous block). A stylesheet change that only resizes #mover must leave #mixed painting its text. On the wave-7 build the anonymous block the reconcile rebuilt was never laid out again (its clean parent is reused, not re-laid out), and the display list lost the 'Some text' run: text_count 3 -> 2. Fixed by try_reuse_anon_wrapper carrying the wrapper's layout. Run: target/release/azul-doc e2e scripts/layoutperf8_e2e
